submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE full square transparent RGBA game sprite, at least 1024 native pixels, of the exact blue-white ice-sword girl from image 1. This is a minimal edit of frame E07, not a new illustration. Lock the entire head, hair, torso, sleeves, right sword hand in front and left blue-talisman hand behind, weapon positions, robe design, camera, scale, framing and character placement to image 1. Main project style reference is image 4, but retain the already matching art of image 1. Image 5 is ONLY a motion reference: the front leg passes in a compact sagittal plane and does not stay in a long stiff forward kick; do not copy any external character, costume, weapon, scenery, text or effects.
Change only the free FRONT anatomical LEFT lower leg and boot. Keep its upper thigh and knee anatomically connected; soften/flex the knee a little, bring the ankle and boot modestly BACK toward the body so the heel is closer below the knee, reducing the long split stride by about one quarter. The boot should continue pointing screen RIGHT along E, its sole nearly level with a natural slight toe lift, NOT swivel toward the viewer or show its whole underside. Keep this front left boot still above the ground, descending toward the next landing. The rear anatomical RIGHT support leg and boot keep the current rear support position and forefoot pressure; do not lift both feet and do not switch the support foot. Keep two legs, two arms, one sword, one blue rectangular talisman. Retain natural knee/ankle/boot longitudinal alignment. No entire-character translation, no clipping, no extra limbs, no shadows, no ground, no grid, no text, no montage. Fully transparent background.
